seasons.note: Our first pick: warm, long days before the peak heat arrives, with the coast and the mountain passes both open.
seasons.bestFor: The whole country in one trip

seasons.note: High summer. Hot, crowded on the Riviera, and the traffic can be heavy: our own travellers suggest going earlier or later in the year.
Our second pick: the sea still warm, the towns quieter, and the hills at their best for walking.
